title: Empty mesh causes SurfaceTools::generate_tangents to fail the null resource check
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.stable

### System information

OSX Sequoia 15.5

### Issue description

The following error is shown in console:
```
E 0:00:00:224   node_3d.gd:10 @ _ready(): Condition "!res" is true.
  <C++ Source>  scene/resources/surface_tool.cpp:1184 @ generate_tangents()
  <Stack Trace> node_3d.gd:10 @ _ready()
```

In [surface_tool.cpp#L1182](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6c9765d87e142e786f0190783f41a0250a835c99/scene/resources/surface_tool.cpp#L1182) a null check is performed on the resource. 

When the mesh is empty this assertion is triggered. 

If empty meshes are allowed, this assertion should not be triggered.
If empty meshes are not allowed, the assertion message should be updated correspondingly. 

Related issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/92395

### Steps to reproduce

Create a node3d and add this code to the _ready() function:
```
func _ready():
	var st = SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	st.set_uv(Vector2(1,1))
	st.generate_normals()
	st.generate_tangents()
	st.commit()  
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See "steps to reproduce".
